frozen: 2026-11-21, before any fusion result was computed (thresholds written down first, as Akhil asked)

synthetic_odometry.SYNTHETIC: odometry is generated, not measured: label-path increments plus sampled drift
synthetic_odometry.model: floor + random walk (week 2 'floorwalk' form e = sqrt(a^2 + b*delta)); not the power law
synthetic_odometry.floor_source: eval/results/vio/drift_params.json floorwalk a (TUM VI indoor VIO)
synthetic_odometry.random_walk: per step of length d (m, along the label path): drift += N(0, b*d/2) per horizontal axis
synthetic_odometry.floor: each odometry position also carries white N(0, a^2/2) per axis
synthetic_odometry.b_rule: b = (X/100)^2 * D_ref, so the RMS horizontal drift after D_ref = 10 km is X % of 10 km and grows as sqrt(distance): X % * sqrt(D_ref * D)
synthetic_odometry.filter_odometry_noise: matched: per step covariance (b*|u|/2 + a^2) I, with |u| the measured increment length

prior.source: loader prior of the first frame (label + N(0, 50 m) per axis, seed 0)

fix_model.factor: max-mixture: the inlier (sigma(ratio)) or outlier (sigma_out) Gaussian, whichever explains the residual better at each relinearisation, with its weight and normalisation as a constant extra residual

thinning.source: eval/results/week6/thinning_05.json (flight 05 fix-error autocorrelation, first lag with both axes < 1/e)
thinning.rule: fuse a candidate only if at least interval_s has passed since the last FUSED fix; candidates rejected by the gate do not reset the timer

chi2_gate.statistic: d2 = nu^T (P_pred + sigma_inlier^2 I)^-1 nu, nu = fix - predicted position

validity.sigma_definition: s = sqrt(largest eigenvalue of the 2x2 fused position covariance), metres, 1-sigma
validity.aging_rationale: 1.5 x the fix inlier sigma (~21 m per axis): the belief has grown clearly beyond what one fix gives
validity.dnp_rationale: 2 x the initial prior sigma (50 m): worse than knowing nothing but the start prior
rules: DO_NOT_PUBLISH if no fix has been fused yet or s > dnp_sigma_m
UNCERTAIN if the last fused fix had P(wrong) > strong_fix_max_p_wrong

no_bias_state: no bias/offset state is estimated (Akhil's rule); no lag correction, no rotation prior

evaluation.note: errors are against dataset labels and include label registration error
